== Title ==
<span lang="ja">暗黒卿の肖像</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">相手が自分より3フォース以上多くフォースを発生させている時に4フォース消費して任意の位置に配備する。その位置と隣接位置では、そこに人員を持っていないプレイヤーはフォースを発生させることができない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ベイダーのホログラムは彼の軍団に絶対の忠誠を誓わせる。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Image Of The Dark Lord.

'''Lore''' — Vader’s hologram exacts absolute loyalty from his legions.

'''Game text''' — When the opponent is generating at least 3 Force more than you, spend 4 Force to deploy at any location. At that location and adjacent locations, a player with no presence there cannot generate Force.

The Japanese face names only that location and adjacent locations. The English face also includes the same site as Vader. Both require the opponent to be generating at least 3 Force more than you.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-imageofthedarklord.gif|Original English face]], [[Image Of The Dark Lord]].</ref>
